text:
lia-mkt: new proposal: "Spark Starter Snacks" 1 mini-series for dev onboarding. each entry = 3minute read + 1 tiny refapp. low friction. thoughts? :zap:
devrel-jo: absolutely. keep the CTA: "Run this in <5 mins". include a one-file refapp and a 1-line benchmark snapshot.
harry-eng: agree. refapp should be 3 endpoints: /health, /infer, /embed. single Dockerfile + env var example. I'll write the template.
nina-ux: visuals: 2 GIFs (request->response, and benchmark card). use consistent color/thumbnail for series.
sam-ops: infra notes: include an example config for Dedicated and a short note for Private (quantized). add a small cost estimate callout.
devrel-jo: distribution play: blog post + community newsletter + 1 tweet thread + pinned issue in Reference Examples repo. encourage community PRs with "good first refapp" label.
lia-mkt: timeline: week 0 scaffold + baseline bench, week 1 snack #1 publish, week 2 snack #2, week 3 snack #3 + live office hours (30m). goal: first 3 weeks as pilot.
harry-eng: bench plan: three profiles to compare: hosted-small, dedicated-default, private-quantized. capture p50, p95, and cost/1k tokens. I'll produce scripts and a CSV artifact.
devrel-jo: content checklist: short explainer, code snippet, screenshot, benchmark card, tutorial repo link, contributor credit.
nina-ux: I'll create a tiny template for the screenshot + GIFs so it looks consistent across posts.
lia-mkt: inbound routing: add a microform at bottom of blog with fields: use-case, company size, demo interest. hook into a sheet and zap to sales if "enterprise" checked.
sam-ops: security note: add a banner reminding not to commit API keys and link to best practices.
devrel-jo: I'll draft Snack 1 ("Build a reranker in 10 minutes") today and ping for review. :rocket:
